glossary.def: Literally installing the life breath; the temple rite that makes an image a living presence. Sadhguru uses it for his consecrations, such as the Dhyanalinga.
A seal or gesture; in yoga, a position of the body, hands or eyes held to direct attention or energy.
The first yogi; Sadhguru's name for Shiva as the source of yoga, presented as a teacher more than as a god to be worshipped.
Mark or sign; the rounded upright form in which Shiva is worshipped in temples.

sadhguru: Born Jagadish Vasudev 3 Sep 1957 Mysore; parents B.V. Vasudev (ophthalmologist, railway hospital) and Susheela; youngest of five; English literature, University of Mysore; poultry farm; Buildaids construction; 23 Sep 1982; first class 1983; Sahaja Sthiti Yoga; married Vijayakumari 1984; Radhe 1990; Vijji died 23 Jan 1997; Isha 1992; land 1994; Padma Vibhushan 2017; Project GreenHands 2004, award 2010 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sadhguru and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Isha_Foundation

Malladihalli Raghavendra 27 Jul 1890-21 Aug 1996; Anatha Sevashrama Trust, Malladihalli, Chitradurga; Jaggi 12 or 13, Swami about 81; Subramaniam 2013 p.52 -> https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malladihalli_Raghavendra

Chamundi Hill account: rock, eyes open, 'What was me was spread all over the place', 5-10 minutes vs 4.5 hours (3:00-7:30 pm), shirt wet with tears, recurred once 13 days, voice and eyes changed within ~6 weeks -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/wisdom/article/sadhguru-enlightenment-experience
First class 1983 Mysuru, seven participants; 200-acre centre; 21-week hatha yoga teacher training; Isha 'born in 1993' -> https://www.theweek.in/theweek/cover/sadhgurus-isha-yoga-centre.html
Seventh Hill seen from bend in road; land registered on eleventh day -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/sadhguru/mission/the-birth-of-isha-yoga-center
Dhyanalinga consecration completed 24 June 1999 -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/blog/article/dhyanalinga-his-only-obsession
Dhyanalinga: prana pratishtha took three years; no rituals or prayers; total silence -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/wisdom/article/what-is-dhyanalinga
Bilva ~400 years ago, snake charmer, present-day Madhya Pradesh, tied to tree, snakebite, watched breath -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/sadhguru/mystic/bilva
Shivayogi: 'He touched me with his stick'; guru communicated technology to consecrate Dhyanalinga -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/global/en/sadhguru/mystic/shivayogi
Sadhguru Sri Brahma: 70 institutions in Tamil Nadu; left body on Seventh Hill; 'This one will come back again' -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/us/en/sadhguru/mystic/sadhguru-sri-brahma

Quotes 'The nature and basis of your experience is within you', 'Technology means doing something the way it works', 'stress is your creation' -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/wisdom/article/doing-the-right-things-with-yourself

Shambhavi: mudra = seal, 'you lock it'; 21-minute practice; preparation 'to get you to the right level of receptivity'; at least ninety days; '6.4 years younger' claim -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/wisdom/article/what-is-shambhavi-mahamudra
Adiyogi 'represents the 112 ways'; 'seekers, not believers' -> https://isha.sadhguru.org/en/blog/article/prime-minister-unveil-112-ft-tall-face-adiyogi-mahashivratri

Adiyogi unveiled by Modi on Mahashivaratri 24 Feb 2017, 112 ft -> https://www.deccanchronicle.com/nation/in-other-news/240217/coimbatore-narendra-modi-unveils-112-feet-shiva-statue-on-mahashivaratri.html
Inner Engineering, Harmony, 20 Sep 2016, NYT bestseller -> https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/247948/inner-engineering-by-sadhguru/

Sounds True interview, Tami Simon, 23 Jan 2018, 69 min; Adiyogi tradition 'more than 10,000 years ago' -> https://www.soundstrue.com/a/resources/podcast/sadhguru-jaggi-vasudev-the-immensity-of-i-dont-know
Brain surgery 17 Mar 2024, Indraprastha Apollo, subdural haematoma, chronic bleed 3-4 weeks -> https://www.onmanorama.com/news/india/2024/03/20/sadhguru-jaggi-vasudev-brain-surgery.html

1997 complaint by then father-in-law; NIE report 10 Oct 1997; dismissed by Coimbatore Police; Isha: 'a baseless charge that was brought up by a few motivated groups'; Divya Spandana post 4 Mar 2019 -> https://www.theweek.in/news/india/2019/03/05/congress-it-cell-murder-charge-sadhguru.html

HC order 30 Sep 2024; SC 3 Oct stay (Chandrachud CJ, Pardiwala, Misra JJ) and transfer; 18 Oct closure, both women major -> https://www.scconline.com/blog/post/2024/10/18/habeas-corpus-petition-against-isha-yoga-centre-closed-supreme-court-legal-news/
